title: Pinging The Voyager 2 Probe (PART 2)
summary: Part two of EEVblog's visit to the NASA/CSIRO Canberra Deep Space Communication Complex, showing the control room and how operators contact Voyager 2. It includes live data and spectrum displays.
why: Commenters recommend the series for hearing an operations supervisor explain how Voyager signals are actually received.

quote.text: Dave Jones of EEVBlog has a nice series of videos talking to Richard Stephenson, Operations Supervisor at the DSN's Canberra site.
